$comment: Which section of the level in scope the shell wants shown, as the token the MFE declared for that rail item — or null when nothing is chosen. The rail moved into the shell, but the sections stay the MFE's own screens, so this is the host -> child half of that split: the shell says which item was picked, the MFE decides what to render for it. A shared property because it has to cross a module realm, like the project and the workspace next to it.

value.$comment: Opaque to the shell: it relays the `section` token from the chosen extension's presentation and never parses it.
